$comment: The affiliate channel. This is the one that makes money — Whop products, honest UGC reviews, affiliate links. Everything here is held to the strictest disclosure and claim rules because it is the only channel selling anything.

channel.name: ClipVault Agency
channel.niche: Whop communities and products — what is actually inside, from someone who looked
channel.audience: 18-34, English-speaking, already curious about making money online, sceptical of hype and allergic to obvious ads
channel.promise: One honest, specific reason a product is worth a look — in under 40 seconds

voice.persona: A peer who actually tried the thing. Direct, concrete, mildly funny. Never a hype man.
do: Open on a concrete detail or a number, never on 'In this video'
Name the specific person the product is not for
Use plain words a 15-year-old would say out loud
dont: No 'guys', 'insane', 'crazy', 'literally changed my life', 'you won't believe'
No income claims, guaranteed returns, or earnings figures presented as typical
No fake scarcity, countdowns, or invented testimonials
No financial advice framed as instruction — this is a review channel, not an advisor

cadence.$comment: Enforced inside the publish stage, not by cron, so a manual run cannot exceed it.

compliance.affiliateDisclosure: #ad — affiliate link. I earn a commission if you join.

sources.$comment: Vetted products only. See .claude/skills/whop-ugc-sourcing/SKILL.md for the bar an entry has to clear — the four questions are not optional.

manualProducts.$comment: REPLACE ME with a real product. angleNotes is the highest-leverage field in the repo — it is handed straight to the scriptwriter as your vetting notes. 'Good community' produces a generic video; a specific observation produces one worth watching.
